info.title: flwn-data-engine
info.description:
REST API for the flwn data engine: workspace memory, files, meetings, atoms, planning and collaboration.

**Authentication.** Two kinds of caller:

- **Agents** send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Mint a token with `POST /auth/tokens`; its scopes
  decide which endpoints it may call, and it is locked to one workspace.
- **The trusted backend** sends the service key in `X-Data-Api-Key`, and `X-Acting-Member-Id` to act
  for a member. Endpoints marked "Trusted backend only" accept nothing else.

**Reading this page.** Endpoints are grouped by tag and collapsed. Open a group, then an
endpoint, to see its parameters, an example request body and the response schemas.
All request and response models are listed under **Schemas** at the bottom.

get.description: Returns 200 while the process is up. No auth.
Checks the database and storage. 503 when a dependency is down. Needs the service key.

post.description: Trusted backend only. Returns a signed token locked to one workspace, limited to the requested scopes. Without `scopes` it can only read memory and files.
Store one memory. Near-identical text is deduplicated and `deduplicated` is true. Needs `memory:write`.

get.description: Newest first, cursor-paginated. Filter by `source` or `agent`; superseded memories are hidden unless `include_superseded`. Needs `memory:read`.

schema.title: Response Purge Workspaces  Workspace Id  Memories Delete

delete.description: Deletes every memory in the workspace. Irreversible. Pass `confirm` equal to the workspace id. Trusted backend only.

post.description: Store up to 50 memories in one call. Results keep the request order. Needs `memory:write`.

schema.title: Response Recall Workspaces  Workspace Id  Memories Recall Post

post.description: Semantic search over memory, ranked by score. Optionally limit to some `sources`. Needs `memory:read`.

get.description: Counts of total, active, superseded, pinned and never-recalled memories, plus a per-source breakdown.

post.description: Delete stale memories using `retention_days`. Use `dry_run` to preview. Trusted backend only.
Cluster similar memories and merge or supersede duplicates. Use `dry_run` to preview. Trusted backend only.
Runs the end-of-sprint cleanup. Same result shape as cleanup. Trusted backend only.

get.description: Fetch one memory. 404 if it is not in this workspace.

patch.description: Replace the text of a memory. Needs `memory:write`.

post.description:
Registers the file and returns a one-time `upload_url`. PUT the bytes there, then call **Complete upload**. Needs `files:write`.

Returns a short-lived URL. PUT the bytes to it with the returned headers, then call
`complete`. Meeting recordings can only be registered by the trusted backend (service key),
because they must come from a meeting where everyone consented.

Semantic search over indexed file text. Returns the best matching chunks with page and heading. Needs `files:read`.

Search inside indexed files by meaning and exact words. Results cite file, page, heading.

schema.title: Response Search Workspaces  Workspace Id  Files Search Post

post.description: Re-run indexing, for example after an indexing error. Needs `files:write`.
Call after the bytes are uploaded. Needs `files:write`.

get.description: Metadata and indexing status for one file. Needs `files:read`.
Returns a short-lived signed URL. Needs `files:read`.

post.description:
Creates a meeting with optional participants. The caller becomes host. Needs `meetings:write`.

The acting member hosts and is added as a participant.

get.description:
Filter by `status` or `project_id`. Needs `meetings:read`.

Members see the meetings they host or attend; the trusted backend sees all.
Includes each participant's consent status. Needs `meetings:read`.

patch.description:
Rename, reschedule, or set `live`, `ended` or `canceled`. Needs `meetings:write`.

Host only. `live` stamps the start time, `ended` and `canceled` the end time.

post.description: Adds workspace members. Each starts with consent pending. Needs `meetings:write`.

put.description:
Grant or decline consent to be recorded. Needs `meetings:write`.

A participant agrees to (or declines) being recorded. Only for themselves.

post.description:
Registers a recording and returns an upload ticket. Needs `meetings:write`.

Trusted backend only, and only once every participant has granted consent. Returns an
upload link like the files API; `complete` the file, then it is transcribed automatically.

put.description:
Replaces the meeting transcript with the given timed segments. Needs `meetings:write`.

Hand in a ready-made transcript (for example live captions). Replaces the earlier one.

get.description: Returns segments in order, paginated. Needs `meetings:read`.

post.description:
Record that a proposal contradicts an earlier decision memory. Needs `conflicts:write`.

Flag a proposal that contradicts a decision. An identical open flag is reused.

get.description: Includes the decision text and the flagged proposal. Needs `conflicts:read`.

put.description:
Mark it `accepted`, `dismissed` or `resolved`, with an optional note.

Trusted backend only, acting as a human member (X-Acting-Member-Id). Agent tokens are
refused, so an agent can never close its own flag.

post.description: An atom is a scheduled agent with daily run, cost and action budgets. Starts as a draft. Needs `atoms:admin` (a human member's token) or the service key acting as a human member.

get.description: Needs `atoms:admin` (a human member's token) or the service key acting as a human member.
What the scheduler needs to decide what to run next. Trusted backend only.

post.description: Releases runs stuck for longer than `older_than_seconds`. Trusted backend only.

get.description: Returns one atom. Needs `atoms:admin` (a human member's token) or the service key acting as a human member.

patch.description: Rename it, change budgets or model tier, or set `draft`, `paused` or `killed`. Null values are rejected. Needs `atoms:admin` (a human member's token) or the service key acting as a human member.

delete.description: Returns 204. Needs `atoms:admin` (a human member's token) or the service key acting as a human member.

post.description: Adds a new instruction version. It does nothing until activated. Needs `atoms:admin` (a human member's token) or the service key acting as a human member.
Makes the version live and the atom active. Needs `atoms:admin` (a human member's token) or the service key acting as a human member.
Re-activates an earlier version. Needs `atoms:admin` (a human member's token) or the service key acting as a human member.

put.description: Gives the atom `summary`, `read` or `write` access to one resource. Needs `atoms:admin` (a human member's token) or the service key acting as a human member.

delete.description: Returns 204. Needs `atoms:admin` (a human member's token) or the service key acting as a human member.

post.description: Give exactly one of `cron` or `interval_minutes` (at least 5). Needs `atoms:admin` (a human member's token) or the service key acting as a human member.

put.description: Needs `atoms:admin` (a human member's token) or the service key acting as a human member.

delete.description: Needs `atoms:admin` (a human member's token) or the service key acting as a human member.

put.description: Updates a toolkit connection in place. `toolkit_version` must be pinned, not `latest`. Needs `atoms:admin` (a human member's token) or the service key acting as a human member.

delete.description: Needs `atoms:admin` (a human member's token) or the service key acting as a human member.

put.description: Links the atom to a Composio toolkit account with a permission ceiling and an allow-list of tools. Needs `atoms:admin` (a human member's token) or the service key acting as a human member.

post.description: Attaches a promoted skill version to the atom. Needs `atoms:admin` (a human member's token) or the service key acting as a human member.

patch.description: Needs `atoms:admin` (a human member's token) or the service key acting as a human member.

post.description: Starts a run for a schedule slot. `idempotency_key` guards against duplicate runs. Fails if a daily budget would be exceeded. Trusted backend only.
An atom asks a human to approve one tool call before it runs. Needs `atoms:run`.

get.description: What the executor should run next. Trusted backend only.

post.description: Creates the run that will carry out an approved action. Trusted backend only.
Locks an approved action so only one executor runs it. Needs `atoms:run`.

put.description: Record `succeeded`, `failed` or `unknown` and the tool result. Needs `atoms:run`.

post.description: Makes a local skill available to the whole workspace. Needs `atoms:admin` (a human member's token) or the service key acting as a human member.

delete.description: Soft delete. Needs `atoms:admin` (a human member's token) or the service key acting as a human member.

post.description: Trusted backend only. A user is a person's global account; they join workspaces as members. Email is unique ignoring case.

get.description: Trusted backend only. Paginated with `limit` and `offset`.

patch.description: Only the fields you send change. Trusted backend only.

delete.description: Soft delete. Their memberships are not changed. Trusted backend only. Returns 204.

post.description: Trusted backend only. `slug` is lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

get.description: Paginated with `limit` and `offset`. Trusted backend only.
Needs a token for this workspace with `identity:read`.

patch.description: Only the fields you send change. Needs a token with the `admin` scope.

delete.description: Soft delete. Needs a token with the `admin` scope.

post.description: `type` is `HUMAN` (needs name and email) or `AI` (needs name and `agent_kind`). Role is `owner`, `admin`, `member` or `viewer`.

patch.description: Change role, status, name, email or settings.

post.description: `key` is a short unique code such as `ENG`.

patch.description: Only the fields you send change.

put.description: Sets the full member list. Members not listed are removed.

post.description: `key` becomes the prefix of task identifiers, for example `DATA-1`.
A work item groups related tasks, for example one feature.
Each task gets a number and identifier such as `DATA-1`. Needs the `work_item_id` it belongs to.

patch.description: Only the fields you send change.

post.description: Status is `planned`, `active` or `completed`. `end_date` cannot be before `start_date`.

patch.description: Only the fields you send change.

delete.description: Hard delete. Its tasks are kept and go back to the backlog (`sprint_id` becomes null). Returns 204.

post.description: Attach a comment to a task, work item, project, project update, sprint or doc. Set `parent_comment_id` to reply.

get.description: Filter by `target_type` and `target_id`. Paginated with `limit` and `offset`.

post.description: A doc is a page made of blocks. Can nest under `parent_doc_id`.

get.description: Metadata only. Fetch the content with **List doc blocks**.

patch.description: Only the fields you send change.

get.description: In display order. Paginated with `limit` and `offset`.

post.description: `type` is a block type such as `paragraph` or `heading_1`; `content` depends on the type.

patch.description: Change type, content, parent or position.

post.description: `type` is `team`, `project`, `group`, `dm` or `agent`. Team channels need `team_id`; project channels need `project_id`.

put.description: Sets the full member list. Members not listed are removed.

post.description: Set `parent_message_id` to reply in a thread.
